iPhone 17 Original Battery

This is a genuine Apple battery for the iPhone 17 — the original 3,692 mAh lithium-ion cell with Apple's factory battery management system, not an aftermarket copy. A genuine battery restores the phone's rated endurance of up to 30 hours of video playback, its factory fast-charging behavior, and Apple's safety standards. Every unit is capacity-tested before sale.

Battery technology and specifications

Capacity: 3,692 mAh in the physical-SIM variant sold in Bangladesh [VERIFY: stocked variant; eSIM-only variants carry a slightly larger cell]. Interestingly, the iPhone 17's efficiency — particularly its LTPO ProMotion display — lets it outlast some larger-capacity phones; that efficiency equation only works with a genuine cell delivering true rated capacity.

Power management: Apple's factory battery management circuitry governs charging curves, thermal limits, and Battery Health reporting accuracy — the component copy batteries compromise on, and the difference between predictable degradation and a cell that overheats or swells.

Charging behavior: Restores the factory charging profile — fast charging up to 50% in around 20 minutes with Apple's 40W adapter, and MagSafe wireless charging up to 25W with a 30W or higher adapter.

Safety: Genuine Apple cells meet Apple's thermal and overcharge protection standards — the most important safety factor in any battery replacement.

Why a genuine iPhone battery matters?

A degraded battery shows up as faster percentage drain, slowdowns under peak load, and eventually a battery service message in iOS. A genuine replacement resolves all three as Apple designed: full rated capacity, restored peak performance capability, and correct Battery Health reporting.
